description: This file contains shell script code to set up a Git repository integrated with Subversion (svn), and performs various tests on 'git svn' operations, particularly focusing on 'svn log' with revision ranges, including edge cases and boundary conditions.

methods.name: svn_cmd
methods.description: External method to execute Subversion commands

methods.name: git svn init
methods.description: Initialize a git repository with Subversion tracking

methods.name: git svn fetch
methods.description: Fetch latest changes from SVN into git

methods.name: git reset
methods.description: Reset current HEAD to a specific state

methods.name: git svn log
methods.description: Show a Subversion log in git

methods.name: git svn find-rev
methods.description: Find git commit corresponding to a svn revision or symbol
